digest.component_or_area: store local git operations and write-lock serialization
propositions: Local git call sites under high concurrent use experience unbounded contention on shared lock files (.git/index.lock, ref locks) with no absorption policy, surfacing errors to agents instead of retrying silently.

Per-store advisory lock plus bounded jittered retry/backoff on all index-mutating store git invocations absorbs transient contention automatically; only genuinely stuck locks (bounded timeout exhausted) surface actionable errors naming the lock file and remediation.

Uncontended store git writes must add zero latency (no happy-path sleep), and every local-only git call site must be bounded with a watchdog timeout justified against local latency (not network latency), or explicitly documented as deliberately unbounded with reason stated.

Rebar's blocking policy under local contention is bounded jittered retry with silent transient recovery, consistent with git lockfile.c backoff and Gerrit's operation-retry pattern, rather than block-forever or fail-fast.
